goal: Die in I75 bewusst offene minimale binäre Health-Projektion für den bereits autorisierten I74 Database-Readiness-Vertrag explizit entscheiden, ohne Provider oder eingefrorene Bereiche zu ändern

guide_delta.summary: I76 autorisiert ausschließlich Database Ready -> HealthLevel.OK und Database Not Ready -> HealthLevel.ERROR. WARNING bleibt unbenutzt; Provider, Runtime und CP-03/CP-08 bleiben geschlossen.

tests_required: confirm I74 readiness remains exactly readable/compatible versus not readable/not compatible
confirm existing HealthLevel exposes OK and ERROR without changing view models
confirm WARNING is not assigned by this binary projection
Manifest V2 and strict write_files scope validation green
tests_explicitly_not_run: product tests because no product code changes
database regressions because storage is untouched
TUI runtime tests because runtime is untouched
full suite because I76 is scope-only
visual evidence because no UI changes exist
risks: the projection is intentionally coarse and does not represent degraded states
a later provider must not broaden readiness or invent WARNING semantics
non_changes: no events, writer lifecycle, Composition Root or starter
expected_side_effects: the minimal readiness-to-health mapping becomes explicit
a later isolated provider iteration can implement the mapping without inventing product semantics
